FarmerProfile.title: FarmerProfile
FarmerProfile.description: Persistent profile, workshop step, vertical rack configuration, deployed hydroponic tiers, and El Nino drought resilience metrics for a student farmer.

farmerKey.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex digest derived from normalized farmerName and passcode.

farmerName.description: Display name chosen by the learner.

activeZone.description: Current area the farmer is standing in.

kitchenStep.description: Current fabrication step inside the kitchen workshop.

rackSize.description: Selected vertical rack stand capacity (2 to 6 PVC pipe tiers).

tiers.description: Bounded list (max 6) of deployed PVC tiers, planted crop IDs, and planting/watering timestamps.

totalHarvestedCount.description: Total number of crops harvested across sessions.

jojoInstalled.description: Whether the farmer has crafted the outdoor JoJo rainwater harvesting tank.

jojoLitres.description: Remaining stored water in litres inside the JoJo rainwater tank.

jojoCapacity.description: Maximum storage capacity in litres of the JoJo rainwater tank.

shadeClothInstalled.description: Whether the 40% agricultural shade-cloth canopy is installed over the vertical rack.

weatherMode.description: Current simulated El Nino weather forecast phase.

litresSaved.description: Cumulative water saved in litres compared to conventional open-soil gardening.

foodServings.description: Total fresh household food servings produced from harvested tiers.

door3DripBottleType.description: Selected 2L bottle variant for Door 3 Workstation 1.

door3CompostContainer.description: Selected composter container (bucket, crate, or pallet) for Door 3 Workstation 2.

door3CompostRejectTested.description: Number of non-compostable avoid items inspected in Workstation 2 (0 to 4).

door3MulchMaterial.description: Selected mulch shield material (cardboard or newspaper) for Door 3 Workstation 3.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when farmer profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest saved state.

/farmers/{farmerKey}.description: Stores each farmer's persistent kitchen fabrication progress, vertical rack size, timestamped tier crops, and El Nino drought resilience metrics.
